treatment_summary.value: Valproate begun but associated with lethargy (worsening later attributed to valproate given the metabolic diagnosis); then lamotrigine with fair seizure control. Lives in a group home.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Urine organic acids showed 4-hydroxybutyric aciduria; enzymatic quantification of SSADH activity in leucocytes confirmed the diagnosis.
